CVE-2025-59731.title: When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, ...
CVE-2025-59731.description:
When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, the specified raw length of run-length-encoded data is not checked when using it to calculate the output data.

We read rle_raw_size from the input file at [0], we decompress and decode into the buffer td->rle_raw_data of size rle_raw_size at [1], and then at [2] we will access entries in this buffer up to (td->xsize - 1) * (td->ysize - 1) + rle_raw_size / 2, which may exceed rle_raw_size.




We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2025-59732.title: When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, ...
CVE-2025-59732.description:
When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, there's an implicit assumption that the height and width are divisible by 8.

If the height or width of the image is not divisible by 8, the copy loops at [0] and [1] will continue to write until the next multiple of 8.

The buffer td->uncompressed_data is allocated in decode_block based on the precise height and width of the image, so the "rounded-up" multiple of 8 in the copy loop can exceed the buffer bounds, and the write block starting at [2] can corrupt following heap memory.



We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2025-59733.title: When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, ...
CVE-2025-59733.description:
When decoding an OpenEXR file that uses DWAA or DWAB compression, there's an implicit assumption that all image channels have the same pixel type (and size), and that if there are four channels, the first four are "B", "G", "R" and "A". The channel parsing code can be found in decode_header. The buffer td->uncompressed_data is allocated in decode_block based on the xsize, ysize and computed current_channel_offset.

The function dwa_uncompress then assumes at [5] that if there are 4 channels, these are "B", "G", "R" and "A", and in the calculations at [6] and [7] that all channels are of the same type, which matches the type of the main color channels.

If we set the main color channels to a 4-byte type and add duplicate or unknown channels of the 2-byte EXR_HALF type, then the addition at [7] will increment the pointer by 4-bytes * xsize * nb_channels, which will exceed the allocated buffer.





We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2025-59734.title: It is possible to cause an use-after-free write in SANM decoding  ...
CVE-2025-59734.description:
It is possible to cause an use-after-free write in SANM decoding with a carefully crafted animation using subversion <2.

When a STOR chunk is present, a subsequent FOBJ chunk will be saved in ctx->stored_frame. Stored frames can later be referenced by FTCH chunks. For files using subversion < 2, the undecoded frame is stored, and decoded again when the FTCH chunks are parsed. However, in process_frame_obj if the frame has an invalid size, there’s an early return, with a value of 0. 

This causes the code in decode_frame to still store the raw frame buffer into ctx->stored_frame. Leaving ctx->has_dimensions set to false.

A subsequent chunk with type FTCH would call process_ftch and decode that frame obj again, adding to the top/left values and calling process_frame_obj again.
Given that we never set ctx->have_dimensions before, this time we set the dimensions, calling init_buffers, which can reallocate the buffer in ctx->stored_frame, freeing the previous one. However, the GetByteContext object gb still holds a reference to the old buffer.




Finally, when the code tries to decode the frame, codecs that accept a GetByteContext as a parameter will trigger a use-after-free read when using gb.

GetByteContext is only used for reading bytes, so at most one could read invalid data. There are no heap allocations between the free and when the object is accessed. However, upon returning to process_ftch, the code restores the original values for top/left in stored_frame, writing 4 bytes to the freed data at offset 6, potentially corrupting the allocator’s metadata.

This issue can be triggered just by probing whether a file has the sanm format.







We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2026-107698.description: FFmpeg before 7.1.4 and 8.0.x before 8.0.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ff_rtsp_connect() in libavformat/rtsp.c that follows RTSP 3xx redirects without validating the Location URL. CVE-2026-120210.title: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability  ...
CVE-2026-120210.description: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the IMF demuxer that allows attackers to open files outside the package via unvalidated ASSETMAP Path elements. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF package with '..' or absolute paths to demux local MXF files, probe file existence and size, or trigger server-side requests.

CVE-2026-120243.title: FFmpeg 2.0 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable ...
CVE-2026-120243.description: FFmpeg 2.0 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the Go2Meeting decoder that allows attackers to leak stack memory through out-of-range palette indices. Attackers can craft a G2M3/G2M4 stream with a short Kempf palette so kempf_restore_buf() copies uninitialized stack bytes, including pointers or stack guards, into decoded output.

CVE-2026-120244.title: FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclos ...
CVE-2026-120244.description: FFmpeg 2.1 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in pcx_decode_frame() in libavcodec/pcx.c that leaves scanline buffer bytes uncleared when input ends early. Attackers can supply a crafted truncated RLE-compressed or uncompressed PCX image to leak heap memory contents through the decoded pixels.

CVE-2026-120245.title: FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclo ...
CVE-2026-120245.description: FFmpeg 0.10 through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in sunrast_decode_frame() in libavcodec/sunrast.c that leaves decoded image regions unwritten for truncated input. Attackers can supply a crafted truncated Sun Raster image, RLE-encoded or raw, to leak stale heap contents such as allocator metadata through the decoded picture.

CVE-2026-120246.title: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable ...
CVE-2026-120246.description: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized variable vulnerability in the CDXL decoder that leaks stack memory into decoded pixels via unfilled HAM palette entries. Attackers can craft a type-0 CDXL file whose HAM pixels select unfilled new_palette entries in cdxl_decode_ham8() or cdxl_decode_ham6(), exposing stack bytes and pointer fragments in the BGR24 output.

CVE-2026-120247.title: FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource ...
CVE-2026-120247.description: FFmpeg 2.3 through 9.0.2 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in the Huffyuv decoder that allows attackers to leak heap memory into decoded pixels via short packed-BGR bitstreams. Attackers can craft a Huffyuv BGR24/BGRA video whose entropy data ends early, causing decode_slice() to add uninitialized s->temp[0] bytes into output frames, exposing heap contents.

CVE-2026-125172.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-125172.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that fails to validate NAL unit length prefixes against remaining packet data. Attackers can supply crafted EVC media with oversized 4-byte NAL length prefixes, causing libxevd to read past the packet buffer, crashing the application or exposing adjacent heap memory.

CVE-2026-125173.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libx ...
CVE-2026-125173.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that fails to free pkt_au when an access unit produces no picture. Attackers can supply a crafted EVC stream with many access units containing only parameter sets or non-frame NAL units to exhaust memory in the decoding application.

CVE-2026-125184.title: FFmpeg 6.1 through 9.0.2 contains an information disclosure vulne ...
CVE-2026-125184.description: FFmpeg 6.1 through 9.0.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the CamStudio decoder (libavcodec/cscd.c) that copies uninitialized heap memory into decoded frames when decompressed payloads are short. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI with a CSCD stream whose LZO or zlib frames decompress to fewer bytes than the frame size, recovering heap contents from the decoded or re-encoded output.

CVE-2026-125200.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in liba ...
CVE-2026-125200.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libavcodec/libx265.c because libx265_encode_frame() never frees the rpu.payload allocated by ff_dovi_rpu_generate(). Attackers can supply crafted Dolby Vision HEVC or AV1 files that leak one RPU allocation per encoded frame during libx265 transcoding, causing unbounded memory growth and denial of service.

CVE-2026-125201.title: FFmpeg 7.0 before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap out- ...
CVE-2026-125201.description: FFmpeg 7.0 before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in vk_av1_decode_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_av1.c because the tile-count limit is checked only on entry. Attackers can supply a crafted AV1 stream with more than 256 tiles decoded via the Vulkan hardware accelerator to overflow tile_sizes and corrupt heap memory.

CVE-2026-125215.title: FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vuln ...
CVE-2026-125215.description: FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in ff_dovi_rpu_generate() in libavcodec/dovi_rpuenc.c that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted Dolby Vision RPU metadata. Attackers can supply streams with default or alternating omitted DM blocks to the dovi_rpu bitstream filter with compression enabled, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-125231.title: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vuln ...
CVE-2026-125231.description: FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavcodec/adxdec.c because adx_decode_header() updates the channel layout before validating the sample rate. Attackers can supply a crafted ADX/AAX stream with mid-stream new-extradata side data carrying an invalid sample rate, causing adx_decode() to write through NULL plane pointers and crash the application.

CVE-2026-125238.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-125238.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that returns success when an access unit produces no frame. Attackers can supply a crafted EVC file with truncated or picture-less access units to trigger the av_assert0() on frame->private_ref, aborting any decoding application.

CVE-2026-125244.title: FFmpeg before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bound ...
CVE-2026-125244.description: FFmpeg before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the VVC decoder's sh_entry_points() function in libavcodec/vvc/ps.c. Attackers can supply a crafted VVC (H.266) bitstream whose SPS/PPS tile and WPP layout produces excess entry points, overflowing entry_point_start_ctu and corrupting decoder memory.

CVE-2026-125249.title: FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in ff_vk_de ...
CVE-2026-125249.description: FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in ff_vk_decode_add_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_decode.c that miscalculates the Vulkan hwaccel bitstream buffer size. Attackers can supply a crafted stream with over 2 GiB of slice data per frame, causing memcpy() to write past a smaller pooled host-mapped buffer.

CVE-2026-125256.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerabilit ...
CVE-2026-125256.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in ff_llvidenc_diff_bytes_rvv() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by triggering negative length values in the Huffyuv encoder. Attackers can supply RGB video narrower than 8 or 16 pixels for huffyuv transcoding on RVV-enabled RISC-V builds, causing writes past the encoder's temp buffer.

CVE-2026-125262.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavcodec/lcevcdec.c because LCEVC output picture dimensions are not validated against the allocated frame. Attackers can embed crafted LCEVC enhancement data with differing global configurations in H.264 or HEVC streams to corrupt heap memory in decoding applications.

The channel parsing code can be found in decode_header. The buffer td->uncompressed_data is allocated in decode_block based on the xsize, ysize and computed current_channel_offset.

The function dwa_uncompress then assumes at [5] that if there are 4 channels, these are "B", "G", "R" and "A", and in the calculations at [6] and [7] that all channels are of the same type, which matches the type of the main color channels.

If we set the main color channels to a 4-byte type and add duplicate or unknown channels of the 2-byte EXR_HALF type, then the addition at [7] will increment the pointer by 4-bytes * xsize * nb_channels, which will exceed the allocated buffer.





We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2025-59734.title: It is possible to cause an use-after-free write in SANM decoding  ...
CVE-2025-59734.description:
It is possible to cause an use-after-free write in SANM decoding with a carefully crafted animation using subversion <2.

When a STOR chunk is present, a subsequent FOBJ chunk will be saved in ctx->stored_frame. Stored frames can later be referenced by FTCH chunks. For files using subversion < 2, the undecoded frame is stored, and decoded again when the FTCH chunks are parsed. However, in process_frame_obj if the frame has an invalid size, there’s an early return, with a value of 0. 

This causes the code in decode_frame to still store the raw frame buffer into ctx->stored_frame. Leaving ctx->has_dimensions set to false.

A subsequent chunk with type FTCH would call process_ftch and decode that frame obj again, adding to the top/left values and calling process_frame_obj again.
Given that we never set ctx->have_dimensions before, this time we set the dimensions, calling init_buffers, which can reallocate the buffer in ctx->stored_frame, freeing the previous one. However, the GetByteContext object gb still holds a reference to the old buffer.




Finally, when the code tries to decode the frame, codecs that accept a GetByteContext as a parameter will trigger a use-after-free read when using gb.

GetByteContext is only used for reading bytes, so at most one could read invalid data. There are no heap allocations between the free and when the object is accessed. However, upon returning to process_ftch, the code restores the original values for top/left in stored_frame, writing 4 bytes to the freed data at offset 6, potentially corrupting the allocator’s metadata.

This issue can be triggered just by probing whether a file has the sanm format.







We recommend upgrading to version 8.0 or beyond.

CVE-2026-107698.title: FFmpeg before 7.1.4 and 8.0.x before 8.0.2 contains a server-side ...
CVE-2026-107698.description: FFmpeg before 7.1.4 and 8.0.x before 8.0.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ff_rtsp_connect() in libavformat/rtsp.c that follows RTSP 3xx redirects without validating the Location URL. Malicious RTSP servers can redirect FFmpeg to internal hosts and ports under other schemes, bypassing -protocol_whitelist, to probe internal network services.

CVE-2026-120210.title: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability  ...
CVE-2026-120210.description: FFmpeg 5.0 through 9.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the IMF demuxer that allows attackers to open files outside the package via unvalidated ASSETMAP Path elements. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF package with '..' or absolute paths to demux local MXF files, probe file existence and size, or trigger server-side requests.

Attackers can craft a G2M3/G2M4 stream with a short Kempf palette so kempf_restore_buf() copies uninitialized stack bytes, including pointers or stack guards, into decoded output.

Attackers can supply a crafted truncated RLE-compressed or uncompressed PCX image to leak heap memory contents through the decoded pixels.

Attackers can craft a Huffyuv BGR24/BGRA video whose entropy data ends early, causing decode_slice() to add uninitialized s->temp[0] bytes into output frames, exposing heap contents.

CVE-2026-125172.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that fails to validate NAL unit length prefixes against remaining packet data. Attackers can supply crafted EVC media with oversized 4-byte NAL length prefixes, causing libxevd to read past the packet buffer, crashing the application or exposing adjacent heap memory.

CVE-2026-125173.title: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libx ...
CVE-2026-125173.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that fails to free pkt_au when an access unit produces no picture. Attackers can supply a crafted EVC stream with many access units containing only parameter sets or non-frame NAL units to exhaust memory in the decoding application.

CVE-2026-125184.description: FFmpeg 6.1 through 9.0.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the CamStudio decoder (libavcodec/cscd.c) that copies uninitialized heap memory into decoded frames when decompressed payloads are short. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI with a CSCD stream whose LZO or zlib frames decompress to fewer bytes than the frame size, recovering heap contents from the decoded or re-encoded output.

CVE-2026-125200.description: FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libavcodec/libx265.c because libx265_encode_frame() never frees the rpu.payload allocated by ff_dovi_rpu_generate(). Attackers can supply crafted Dolby Vision HEVC or AV1 files that leak one RPU allocation per encoded frame during libx265 transcoding, causing unbounded memory growth and denial of service.

CVE-2026-125201.description: FFmpeg 7.0 before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in vk_av1_decode_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_av1.c because the tile-count limit is checked only on entry. CVE-2026-125249.description: FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in ff_vk_decode_add_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_decode.c that miscalculates the Vulkan hwaccel bitstream buffer size.
